name: comp-100

frames.best_why: Clean closed hamburger at full size; frames 3-5 are mid-morph with the cursor over the icon.

tagline: Three stacked lines fold into an X when clicked.
summary: An icon button holding a hamburger menu symbol. Clicking it swings the three bars into an X and back again, while announcing whether the menu is open.
appearance: A square icon button with rounded corners and a thin light outline sits on a near-black stage. Three short white horizontal bars are centred inside, evenly spaced. The button keeps the same size while the icon inside changes.
behaviour: At rest the button shows three stacked bars. A click rotates and slides them into an X over about a third of a second with a slight overshoot; a second click returns them to bars.
demo_content: Caption below the button reading "Menu toggle: the hamburger morphs into an X".
search_phrases: three lines that turn into an x
animated close button for slide out nav
button to show and hide navigation
use_when: A compact nav toggle is needed in a top bar where an icon button fits better than a text label.
avoid_when: It only flips its own icon; you must build and wire the menu panel it is meant to control.
customise: No props are exposed; icon size, stroke and timing live in the file, so changing them means editing the source or the shared Button variant.
weight_why: One small SVG with three paths animated by CSS transitions.

a11y.note: aria-label and aria-expanded are set, but the morph ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: No clean open frame: frames 3-5 are mid-morph with the cursor over the icon.
polish_why: Crisp, well-proportioned icon and a springy timing curve; the morph overshoots a touch.
